english_title: Lebesgue Measure of a Region Bounded by a Function
statement_en: Let $f(x)$ be a nonnegative function on $\mathbb{R}^k$, and define $$A:=\{(x,y) \in \mathbb{R}^{k}\times \mathbb{R}:0\leq y \leq f(x)\}.$$ Then the "area" of this set can be computed by integration, namely $$\int_{\mathbb{R}^k} f(x)\,dx = m(A),$$ where $m$ denotes Lebesgue measure.
callout_body:
$f(x)$是$\mathbb{R}^k$上的一个非负的函数，集合$$A:=\{(x,y) \in \mathbb{R}^{k}\times \mathbb{R}:0\leq y \leq f(x)\}$$
那么这个集合的"面积"可以用积分来计算，公式如下:
$$\int_{\mathbb{R}^k} f(x)\,dx = m(A)$$
这里的$m$是集合的Lebesgue测度。
